# Synthetic noise fixture

`colored-noise.flac` contains generated noise. It contains no aircraft recording.
It combines Gaussian noise, low-pass wind noise with a changing level, and a stationary 65 Hz tone.
It is a 30-second excerpt from seconds 200–230 of a ten-minute control with NumPy seed 1985.
The excerpt reproduces a false short-flyover detection at the former 6 dB default.
It is a selected regression case. See [validation coverage](../../docs/limitations.md#input-coverage).

The fixture is generated by this project and uses the repository license.
Its SHA-256 is `1ae6ca0aa2b540d7f1db2bdf680f0d0dbc3f966dc5535b86b9505bfff9c280cb`.
It is mono, 8000 Hz, and 16-bit FLAC. No real-camera audio is included.

Recreate it from the repository root:

```text
python validation/generate_noise_fixture.py --output tests/fixtures/colored-noise.flac
```

NumPy, SciPy and FFmpeg are needed only to recreate the fixture.
The regression uses the checked-in file and the application's normal FFmpeg decoder.
Encoder-version changes can change the file hash.

Use `--seed NUMBER --full-control --output control.wav` to generate a full ten-minute float WAV control.
The default command creates the 30-second regression fixture.
